answer: Tie each agent to one live smart electricity meter. At signup the utility pushes a six-digit code to that meter's liquid crystal display, so only someone at the premises can read it; validators then get a utility-signed confirmation that the code matches and the supply is paid, and store only a salted hash of the meter ID. A clone reusing that meter hits the same hash and is refused, so each extra agent needs another paid supply, like renting a second terrace house. Weakness: an owner of many meters, such as a pearl farm with sheds, needs a per-account-holder cap.
